contributions.basis: no schedule page in the document
contributions.detail: The PDF is ONE page: the Carr 5-5-PG cover only ('Page 1'). Form 'A' is not present. A ZERO-DOLLAR filing: the filer wrote a single round 0 in the TOTALS-FROM-LAST-REPORT column of all four lines and left the THIS-REPORT and CUMULATIVE columns of every line completely EMPTY - confirmed in a 600 dpi crop of the whole four-line block. The zeros sit in the LAST column rather than the CUMULATIVE one, which is the filer's own placement and is recorded as printed rather than shifted.

expenditures.basis: no schedule page in the document
expenditures.detail: Form 'B' is not present in the one-page PDF. Line 3 and line 4 follow the same pattern: a written 0 in the LAST column, empty THIS and CUMULATIVE cells. cover_balance_end is recorded as '' because the CUMULATIVE balance cell is the empty one; the balance LAST cell holds a 0.

gates.balance_chain: Trivially consistent: every reported figure on the filing is 0, and the balance line carries the same 0. Nothing to chain - the LAST/THIS/CUMULATIVE identity cannot be tested where two of the three columns are empty.
